claim_scope: Prospectively frozen, label-free development diagnostic for bidirectional GAFF2/OBC-II/ACE to exact Route 1 MLIP/OBC-II/ACE nonequilibrium switching in gas and implicit solution. The short reused endpoint trajectories and 5-20 fs switches cannot establish equilibrium, production convergence, chemical accuracy, acceleration, confirmation, or product promotion.

route_contract.name: Additive fixed-charge PB/GB implicit solvation
route_contract.reference_mm_role: endpoint sampling and switching bridge only
route_contract.formal_model_agnosticism: Any registered gas-phase MLIP that supplies finite energies and conservative forces on every audited switching configuration can use the same evaluator and switching interface; practical cost and accuracy remain model-, overlap-, and sampling-dependent.

thermodynamic_cycle.primary_switching_estimator: PyMBAR BAR from forward and reverse nonequilibrium work

energy_alignment.cycle_identity: The same C_model_case shifts both phase corrections by -C_model_case and therefore cancels exactly in DeltaF_solution-DeltaF_gas.

reference_potential.solution: GAFF2 fixed-charge molecular mechanics plus OpenMM OBC-II/ACE
reference_potential.charges: The same frozen AM1-BCC vector used by the Route 1 target
reference_potential.radii: Amber mbondi2 embedded in the frozen topology

forward_reference.trajectory_role: GAFF2 gas or GAFF2/OBC-II/ACE solution endpoint

reverse_target.artifact: route1-multi-mlip-obc2-ti-2026-07-25 raw trajectories referenced by the sealed direct-target MBAR artifact

switching.protocol_order: propagate at lambda_t, then perturb at R_t+1
switching.lambda_schedule: equally spaced inclusive endpoints with steps+1 values
switching.velocity_policy: fresh deterministic Maxwell-Boltzmann draw per switch; momenta use the same masses at both endpoints
switching.initialization_seed_formula: case seed + model offset + phase offset + direction offset + length offset + source replicate offset + frame index

analysis.standard_state: gas 1 M to ideal-dilute implicit solution 1 M; configurational indirect correction

decision_policy.reason: Only eight work values per direction are launched from previously sealed but deliberately short endpoint trajectories; the diagnostic can reject the method or motivate a production protocol but cannot validate it.
full_numerical_gate_requires: 20 fs indirect cycle versus direct-target MBAR agreement
common energy alignment and provider parity checks
decision_policy.poor_overlap_action: fail closed; lengthen switching and/or sample real intermediate Hamiltonians rather than adding a hydration-label residual

forbidden_claims: faster than a bare MM force evaluation
universally faster for every molecule or MLIP
accurate without endpoint-equilibrium, work-overlap, uncertainty, and switch-length audits

literature.citation: Scholler A et al. J Phys Chem B 126, 2798-2811 (2022).
literature.role: fewer sufficiently long switches outperform many short switches; work-series and conformational diagnostics

literature.citation: Tkaczyk S et al. J Chem Theory Comput 20, 2719-2728 (2024).
literature.role: MM to ANI-2x comparison of FEP and nonequilibrium switching

literature.citation: Karwounopoulos J et al. J Phys Chem B 128, 6693-6703 (2024).
literature.role: direct solvation precedent: separate gas and aqueous MM-to-NNP switching, linear interpolation, bidirectional BAR, overlap auditing, and broad negative accuracy result

literature.citation: Shirts MR, Chodera JD. J Chem Phys 129, 124105 (2008).
literature.role: upstream PyMBAR estimators and overlap diagnostics

limitations: The literature solvation protocol used 300 switches of 5 ps; this development protocol uses only eight switches per direction at 5 and 20 fs and is intentionally non-production.
The reverse starts are reused from prior 30 fs target diagnostics and cannot establish endpoint equilibrium or conformer mixing.
The three molecules and three registered MLIPs form a development matrix, not a confirmation benchmark.
A pass of numerical work-distribution gates would not show that MLIP intramolecular energetics generally improve fixed-charge implicit-solvation accuracy.
No experimental FreeSolv label may be opened until the label-free switching artifact is sealed.
